prompt: Where does replacement of shed epidermal cells begin?

options.text: At the base of the epidermis, where new cells form
At the surface, where dead cells come back to life
In plasma, which turns into skin

explanation: New cells form at the base of the epidermis to replace those shed from the surface.

options.text: A layer beneath the epidermis, with vessels and nerve endings
The name for dead cells that flake off

explanation: Surface renewal occurs in the epidermis; the dermis is the layer beneath it and contains vessels and nerve endings.
